short.title: POV: Black Friday Is 25 Days Away… and YOU Already Have $300 Ready 🛍️
short.description:
▶️ Full No-Spend November plan: https://youtu.be/ei4HEohqaPg

Black Friday 2026 is November 27th. In 2024 Americans spent about $10.8 billion online on Black Friday alone (Adobe Analytics). But a consumer study by Which? found 98% of Black Friday deals were the same price or cheaper at other times in the 6 months around it.

Your plan: write down the 3 things you actually need, screenshot today's prices, put $12 a day aside (25 days = $300), and on Black Friday buy only what's on your list AND really cheaper.

This video is for educational purposes only and is not financial advice.
